cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: 73s VO-over-b-roll VSL, 38 beats, no lipsync. Traced beat-for-beat from GLP-1 SOS 'Here's what finally fixed my Ozempic constipation' (live 129 days). Angle MOT-A-004: the drug is finally working and it is the reason nothing moves. Mechanism: TOP NOT BOTTOM. Six law-forced deviations, all marked LAW-FORCED on the OUR VERSION cards. Everything else is traced. AWAITING BROOKS APPROVAL before any keyframe render.
